text:
Recommendation: Launch the annual plan at $490/year and offer it first to the 40 customers who asked.
Why:
- Setup is about 1 day, plus $98/yr (2 months) lost per buyer who would otherwise pay for 12 months.
- If all 40 switch, that's $3,920/yr, about 2% of the $176,400/yr currently billed (300 x $588).
- "2 months free" is standard annual pricing, not a discount or promo — call it "annual billing."
- 40 customers already asked for it.
- Set a refund rule for mid-year cancels (e.g., none after 30 days) before launch.
Risks and unknowns:
- Only already-loyal customers might switch, meaning you give up 2 months' revenue without gaining retention.
- If churn is very low and most customers already stay 12+ months, an 11-months-for-the-price-of-12 structure would be better than 2 months free.
Next steps:
1. Build the plan in Stripe and email the 40 interested customers within 1 week, then add it to the pricing page.
2. After 60 days, count how many switched and how many new signups came in.
3. Success if 20+ of the 40 switch; stop or reconsider if new monthly signups fall or customers resist the price.
